'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee match-play major, 20–22 October 2017. [[Steve Baroni]] is published first on the Day 2 list.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 20–22 October 2017
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
